prior_summary: Fresh-TCP body-frame SE(3) residual targets are recomposed from the measured TCP for every executed slot, feedback-recentering moderate handoff and tracking offsets.
applicable_conditions: Prefer at the early place_blue handoff or after modest IK/tracking state mismatch while object-goal relations remain near demonstrated phases. Large source displacement favors h01 and dominant shifted destination after lift favors h02.
termination_guidance: Use the unchanged red_at_goal AND blue_at_goal expression. Local action magnitude and gripper sign do not establish grasp or success; demonstrated opening and high retreat are guidance only.
limitations: Local residuals may accumulate error over long transport and cannot repair missed contact, slip, unstable blue, unseen obstacles or unreachable IK. Large source/goal displacement is not made invariant and unseen-error recovery is unproven.
